summary: Re-verification of iter47 presentation fixes. BOTH FIXES LANDED. (1) Homepage hero at tablet portrait 768x1024 now renders as a TWO-COLUMN layout (text 428px on the left, book cover 252px on the right at x=492), with left-aligned text via `md:text-left` and `flex-col md:flex-row`. The compressed stacked layout from iter47 is gone. At 1024 landscape it remains a clean two-column. At 390 mobile it still collapses to a single column (correct). (2) Quick Order 'Small Group Options' card is now wrapped in `max-w-2xl` (measured 672px) instead of the previous 576px (`max-w-xl`), reducing the empty right band noticeably at both 1440 and 1024. (3) Regression: NO horizontal scrollbar on / or /quick-order at any of 390x844, 768x1024, 1024x768, 1440x900 (scrollWidth equals clientWidth at all 8 combos). July4 featured tiles still wrap 2-up cleanly at 768.

issues: Small Group card is now 672px in a ~976px parent — there is still ~300px of right-side empty space (less than before but visible). Optional polish: `mx-auto` to center, or `max-w-3xl` to push wider. Not a blocker.
Two-column layout is healthy. Minor: book cover (252px) is still notably shorter than the left text column (656px), so a small vertical whitespace gap remains under the cover. Cosmetic only.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Center the Small Group card on >=1024 (`mx-auto`) or bump to `max-w-3xl` to fully balance the section. Current state is acceptable for release.
critical_code_review_comments: SoulFoodApp.js line 571: breakpoint correctly moved to `md:flex-row` with `gap-6 md:gap-10 lg:gap-14` and `text-center md:text-left`. Clean fix.
QuickOrder.js line 968: `max-w-xl` -> `max-w-2xl` applied. Could optionally add `mx-auto` to center on wide viewports.

success_rate.frontend: Presentation re-check PASS: Fix1 verified at 768 & 1024, Fix2 verified at 1440 & 1024, no horizontal scroll regression across 8 viewport/page combos.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter48 confirmed both iter47 fixes shipped. Key measurements captured: hero @ 768 = row direction, left col 428x656 at x=24, right col 252x395 at x=492. SmallGroup wrapper now 672px wide at both 1440 and 1024. Screenshots in /app/test_reports/screenshots_iter48/. No horizontal scroll anywhere. Only remaining cosmetic note is some right-side whitespace next to the Small Group card at 1024 — optional polish, not a blocker.
rca of the issue: n/a — verification pass only; both prior issues resolved.
